name: זִמְרָן
summary: The first son Keturah bore to Abraham (Gen 25:2; 1Ch 1:32), one of the sons Abraham sent away eastward with gifts, away from Isaac (Gen 25:6). The name is the root's זמר with the ending ־ָן; scripture does not explain it, and like זִמְרִי it may be read from “song” or from an older ḏmr “protection”.

evidence.note: Keturah “bore him זִמְרָן and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah”.
Abraham gave gifts to the sons of the concubines and sent them away from Isaac eastward.

note: A reading of the form only; no verse gives the meaning. Some place the people in Arabia; not followed.
